name: Mini-Silk
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c27892]Silk[/url] has an ability to transform into a fairy-like creature. While in this form, she is following [url=https://vndb.org/c27886]Takuya[/url] around on his mission to collect energy necessary for her spell.
translation: [url=https://vndb.org/c27892]Silk[/url] has an ability to transform into a fairy-like creature. While in this form, she is following [url=https://vndb.org/c27886]Takuya[/url] around on his mission to collect energy necessary for her spell.
